2609.35618.title: From cacophony to hierarchy: a principled framework for assessing AI consciousness
2609.35618.paper_summary: The question of AI consciousness is one of the most urgent pre-emptive problems in philosophy and computer science, yet progress is hampered by a cacophony of competing theories that often talk past each other. Separating the hard problem from the mapping problem allows the deepest metaphysical disagreements to be set aside: granting that experience supervenes on a system's organisation, the tractable question becomes at which grain of description that supervenience base sits. We extend Marr's three levels of analysis into a five-level hierarchy of functional descriptions (behavioural, computational, intrinsic causal-structural, organismic, and organism-environment) grounded in supervenience, coarse-graining, and multiple realisability. The major theories of consciousness are positioned within this hierarchy according to which level they take to be critical, and for each level we develop operationalisable indicators and assess current AI systems against them. A Bayesian model then combines theoretical credences with indicator evidence into an overall credence in a system's capacity for consciousness. In illustrative assessments, the verdict for current LLMs is driven as much by where theoretical credence is placed as by how the evidence is read: under different stipulated readings and credence distributions, assessments range from below 0.01 to roughly 0.8, showing sensitivity to assumptions. Finally, the consciousness indicators at each level closely overlap with the architectural features needed for general intelligence, suggesting that increasingly capable AI may become a stronger candidate for consciousness. The framework supports a structured agnosticism, in which theoretical commitments are made explicit, credences are updated as evidence accumulates, and assessments take the form of aggregated probabilities rather than verdicts.
2609.35618.paper_summary_zh: AI 意識的問題是哲學和計算機科學中最緊迫的預防性問題之一，但進展受到許多相互競爭的理論的干擾，這些理論經常互不相干地討論。將硬問題與映射問題分開，可以將最深層的形而上學分歧擱置一旁：假設經驗依賴於系統的組織，易於處理的問題便成為這種依賴基礎位於何種描述的粒度。我們將 Marr 的三個分析層次擴展為一個五層的功能描述層次結構（行為、計算、內在因果結構、有機體和有機體-環境），這些層次基於依賴、粗粒化和多重實現。意識的主要理論根據它們認為關鍵的層次被定位於這一層次結構中，對於每個層次，我們開發可操作的指標並評估當前的 AI 系統。然後，貝葉斯模型將理論信念與指標證據結合，形成對系統意識能力的整體信念。在示範評估中，當前 LLM 的判決同樣受到理論信念放置位置的驅動，也受到證據解讀方式的影響：在不同的規定解讀和信念分佈下，評估範圍從低於 0.01 到大約 0.8，顯示出對假設的敏感性。最後，各層次的意識指標與一般智能所需的架構特徵密切重疊，這表明越來越有能力的 AI 可能成為意識的更強候選者。該框架支持一種結構化的不可知論，其中理論承諾被明確化，隨著證據的積累而更新信念，評估的形式是聚合概率而不是判決。
